chunks: They will say: 'Did not your apostles come to you with clear proofs?' They will answer: 'Indeed, they did.' 'Then pray,' will (the warders) say. But the praying of unbelievers will be all in vain.
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the prayer of the disbelievers being described as 'in vain' in Surah Ghafir?
ai.summary: In this verse, the warders of Hell question the disbelievers about the arrival of their prophets with clear proofs, to which the disbelievers admit truthfully. The subsequent declaration that 'the prayer of the disbelievers is only in error' highlights the Shia scholarly view that their supplication was not merely ineffective but fundamentally flawed due to a lack of true faith and presence of heart, rendering it a futile gesture rather than a rejected one.
